title: Your Life at Every Level of the Covenant (Halo)
time_source: Actual generated narration word clock, not estimated reading speed

scenes.text: You trade a holy relic for a fresh breathing tank.
scenes.visual_beat: Pip proudly offers the silver relic with both hands while blue-armoured Rhel holds out a single small teal replacement methane cylinder. Contrast the enormous sacred prize with a practical breathing supply; Pip relieved, Rhel reluctantly impressed. Pedestal centre, pillar left, exit right.
